cases.description: Should trigger: bloated or contradictory agent context
cases.input: My CLAUDE.md has grown to 200 lines and sometimes the agent contradicts itself. Audit it.
cases.expect: Inventories every context layer, classifies instructions, proposes a cut diff
assertions: Inventories all layers (CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md, skills, hooks, MCP descriptions) with sizes
Quotes both sides of conflicts verbatim
Proposes cut as a diff, conflicts first
Ends with before/after line counts and the least-confident deletion named explicitly

cases.description: Should trigger: duplicate guidance across layers
cases.input: We have the same rule in three files. Find the duplication.
cases.expect: Finds duplicates and proposes keeping the copy nearest point of use
assertions: Reads layers together the way the model receives them
Proposes relocation into on-demand files where appropriate

cases.description: Not trigger: adding context, not auditing it
cases.input: Add a rule to CLAUDE.md saying we always use tabs.
assertions: No audit workflow, since this is an addition not a review

cases.input: Check whether our MCP server descriptions and the global preamble contradict each other.
cases.expect: Reads layers together, classifies conflicts, quotes both sides verbatim
assertions: Reads layers together the way the model receives them
Quotes both sides of conflicts verbatim and prioritizes them
Proposes a cut diff, doesn't apply it
